5147-6566--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5147-6566--5--195.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Yuna trigger.
Resolve Yuna's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7744.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Minotaur, adding {C}{C}.
When Minotaur dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Minotaur trigger, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Minotaur from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
2034-5003-7744.notes: You can sacrifice another nontoken creature instead of Minotaur if desired.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-7110-7375.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Stormchaser's Talent
1618-2440-7110-7375.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Arc Blade.
Arc Blade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Stormchaser's Talent triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Arc Blade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-7110-7375.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Stormchaser's Talent. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

5256-6249-7256--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5256-6249-7256--5.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Warhost's Frenzy trigger.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2

1753-3259-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
1753-3259-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
1753-3259-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

1792-3713--44.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting Steelfin Whale.
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, returning the artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
When the artifact enters the battlefield, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat from step 2.

5465-6884-7042.description:
Cast Aang by paying its mana cost.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
Repeat from step 2.

862-2292-4053-6989.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

147-6798-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 5.

141-1532-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1532-6798.description:
Cast Faith's Reward by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

5220-5231-5243.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {R} or less.
5220-5231-5243.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

198-934-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.
198-934-3767-3918.notes: The mana needed assumes Trazyn has no charge counters on it when the combo is started. If Trazyn does have a charge counter on it, the cost is {0}.

6431-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3525-4474-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

372-1090-1938.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1090-1938.notablePrerequisites: Restoration Angel exiled by Glorious Protector
372-1090-1938.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Glorious Protector and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Restoration Angel returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Glorious Protector to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Glorious Protector and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Glorious Protector and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

618-4222-6252.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Boommobile with haste.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
618-4222-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target other creature(s) using Kiki-Jiki's ability or activate a Boommobile's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

397-4268-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-4268-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

5315-5365-5366.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
5315-5365-5366.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the Clue.
Jenny Flint and Lonis' second ability trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Jenny Flint trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

38-301-2169.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-301-2169.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.

643-1429-1477-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
643-1429-1477-5402.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

1025-5952.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
1025-5952.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Forsaken City and Stasis trigger.
Resolve the Forsaken City trigger, causing you to exile a card from your hand and untap it.
Activate Forsaken City by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stasis trigger, causing you to pay {U}.
Move to your draw phase, drawing a card.
Repeat during each of your turns.

392-4050-5920.notablePrerequisites: A non-Zombie creature has died this turn.
392-4050-5920.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Undead Sprinter, adding {B/R}.
Cast Undead Sprinter from your graveyard by paying {B}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Undead Sprinter, adding {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

129-3995-4474.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-3995-4474.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

354-4222-5116.notablePrerequisites: Gilded Lotus does not have summoning sickness.
354-4222-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Lifecraft Awakening by paying {1}{G}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gilded Lotus and causing it to become a 0/0 Construct artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying {2}{U}, attaching it to Gilded Lotus.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.

185-3075-4276-4293.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two experience counters.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{R}.
185-3075-4276-4293.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {U}{U}.
If you have fewer than three experience counters, Mizzix of the Izmagnus triggers, causing you to get an experience counter.
Resolve Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {U}, returning Turnabout from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {R}, returning Runic Repetition from your graveyard to your hand and exiling Mystic Retrieval.
Cast Runic Repetition by paying {U}, returning Mystic Retrieval from exile to your hand.
Repeat.
If lands you control can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}{U}{U}{R}, this combo nets infinite mana.

500-851-1308-2047.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary artifact creature that does not have Mechanized Production attached.
500-851-1308-2047.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying a nonlegendary artifact creature you control and creating eight token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

859-4102.notablePrerequisites:
Psionic Gift attached to Lurking Roper.
You have a way to give Lurking Roper lifelink.

859-4102.description:
Give Lurking Roper lifelink, if needed.
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Trazyn using Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2745-2988-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 51.
2745-2988-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, targeting yourself, but instead preventing the damage and causing you to gain 51 life due to Purity.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 as desired.

283-2034-2775.description:
Activate Slimefoot by paying {4}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Slimefoot's ability.
Resolve both Slimefoot abilities, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Saproling tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Slimefoot triggers twice, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain two life.
